decisions.reason: As a low-cost extension close to the core assortment, this carpet still has option value, though after two years the firm would start to expect clearer market traction.
This carpet remains inexpensive to keep in the portfolio, but its overlap with other carpet launches raises the likelihood of later pruning if differentiation stays weak.
After two years a niche corner bench should have shown more evidence of demand, and its more specific use and higher carrying complexity make redeploying resources the better option.
The swivel shell chair line fits the firm's strategic push into flexible workplace concepts, so management would continue backing it while the broader line matures.
